info.title: ABU9 (أبو9) Platform API
info.description: Modular-monolith API for customers, couriers, restaurants, logistics partners, creators and operations. Money is integer halalas. Times are UTC ISO-8601; display in Asia/Riyadh.

amount.description: Halalas (1 SAR = 100). VAT-inclusive for consumer amounts.
